context: Evaluates correct use of spprof's native C-stack unwinding API. The candidate must call native_unwinding_available() to guard the feature, call set_native_unwinding(True/False) appropriately, verify state with native_unwinding_enabled(), and handle the RuntimeError when the feature is unavailable.

checklist.name: Availability check
checklist.description: Calls spprof.native_unwinding_available() and branches on its boolean result before calling set_native_unwinding().

checklist.name: Enable unwinding when available
checklist.description: When native_unwinding_available() returns True, calls spprof.set_native_unwinding(True) and then verifies spprof.native_unwinding_enabled() returns True.

checklist.name: RuntimeError when unavailable
checklist.description: When native_unwinding_available() returns False, attempts to call set_native_unwinding(True) and catches or demonstrates the resulting RuntimeError.

checklist.name: Profiling with unwinding
checklist.description: Calls spprof.start() after configuring native unwinding, runs a workload, calls spprof.stop(), and accesses frame.is_native on collected frames.

checklist.name: Disable and verify
checklist.description: Calls spprof.set_native_unwinding(False) after profiling and verifies spprof.native_unwinding_enabled() returns False.
